changelog:
Summary: Major update simplifies the skill to focus on browser-based checklist-driven content reviews, removing automated scripts and technical crawling.

- Removes all script files and advanced technical audit tooling.
- Updates the description to reflect a conversational, browser-based SEO review process.
- Provides new example prompts, clear checklist-style recommendations, and progress tracking guidance.
- Limits functionality to analysis of visible page content only (no crawling, API calls, or deep server checks).
- Tailors the skill for website owners and small businesses seeking user-friendly SEO improvement advice.
